cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Successful Compliance
cards.instruction: Describe a failed outcome as proof that the correct process was followed and therefore the system worked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The wedding cake collapsed, but our final inspection caught it. The system worked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Exactly. No defective cake reached a guest.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The couple want a refund for the entire cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which matches our rejection of the entire cake. I'll record that as full customer agreement with quality control.

confusable: D164 finds a useful benefit; D185 specifically claims the failed outcome proves the correct process and system succeeded.
comparison: A service failure and refund differ from an evacuation drill's literal confinement.
seedUse: Keep inspection, no cake and full refund; make each A turn direct the colleague's actual report.
